title: FastEngine
description: Only minecraft optimization, without unnecessary garbage
body:
> ### Mods for optimization, particle enhancement, recording, smooth interface and easier game play!
> 
> **On average, performance in Benchmarks is 100-150% better than in a vanilla game.**                   
> There are mods to improve the gameplay, suitable for playing on servers!                                 
> Complementary shaders are pre-installed and configured

**Only Sodium OLD**
